messages.subject: Where did the scale go? (Windows on-screen)
parts:
The online docs for geom_point include this code:
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg))
p + geom_point(aes(colour = qsec))
# from the second graph of http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_point.html

The resulting output for me does not have colors shown next to the scale for qcal; image attached as a .png.

This seems to be specific to the on-screen graphics device; when I save as pdf from the file menu of the window shown in the png,, the color bars do appear (attached as pdf).

What's going on and how can I fix it?
